title: delete_entries — soft delete messages (DeletionEntry)
description: Domain: session/message. Source: src/worker_rpc.rs:3788. Soft failures (no/unknown targetIds) are SUCCESS-envelope payloads carrying an `error` key, not RPC errors. Wire envelope (validated separately, not by this schema): worker replies {"id","type":"response","command","success":true,"data":<this payload>} (src/worker_rpc.rs output_response); host replies {"type":"response","id","success":true,"data":<this payload>,"session"?}. Errors use {"success":false,"error":string} with no data.

error.description: Present only on soft failure ("no targetIds" / "no matching entries...").
